title: Todo CRUD Manager with Autocomplete (Dummy Backend)
description: Implement a todo manager that performs create, update, and delete against the dummy backend, and provides an autocomplete search over titles.
requirements: Fetch todos from http://localhost:4000/api/todos on mount and render a loading state with class 'todo-crud-autocomplete loading' and text 'Loading todos...'
After loading, render a root container with class 'todo-crud-autocomplete' and an h1 with text 'Todo CRUD with Autocomplete'
Provide a form with an input (placeholder 'New todo title...') and an Add button that creates a new todo via POST http://localhost:4000/api/todos and appends it to the list
Render todos in a ul with class 'todo-list'; each li should have class 'todo-item' and contain a checkbox bound to completed and a Delete button
Toggling the checkbox should call PATCH http://localhost:4000/api/todos/:id and update the completed state in the UI to match the server
Clicking Delete should call DELETE http://localhost:4000/api/todos/:id and remove the todo from the list

Provide a search input (placeholder 'Search todos...') bound to searchQuery; when the trimmed query is non-empty, show either a 'No matches found.' message with class 'status empty' or a suggestion list ul.suggestions with li.suggestion-item titles filtered from the current todos
The suggestions must stay in sync with CRUD operations (newly created or deleted todos should immediately affect search results)

hints.load: Create a reusable loadTodos helper and call it from useEffect.
hints.create: Use POST with JSON body { title } and append the response todo to state.
hints.updateDelete: PATCH and DELETE should update the local todos array after the server confirms success.
hints.search: Derive suggestions from todos so they automatically reflect any CRUD changes.
